name: title-combo
note: Back to the title (keyboard.cpp TitleCombo, the SDK's kernel::Relaunch), by a controller as SDL reads one: with the setting off, Back and Start held do what the game does with them (its pause menu, closed again); on, held half a second nothing happens and the game gets neither button (no pause menu); held over a second, the game starts again (the same log goes on, cvtest follows the new process and its window) and reaches its title; Continue then loads the new game's save, so the game plays on after it.

expect: not found(log, 'title: Back and Start held')

steps.until: player.active and not menu and not camera.special and not modal
steps.note: its pause menu or map closed
on, held half a second: nothing, and the game got neither button
expect: not found(log, 'title: Back and Start held')

steps.note: held over a second: the game started again

steps.until: player.active and not cutscene and not loading and not menu
steps.note: Continue: the save the new game made, played
